statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-12064 affects only the curl command-line tool: with a URL that has no scheme and --proto-default sftp or scp, the tool guesses a different scheme and skips setting the SSH host verification options, while libcurl connects with SFTP or SCP anyway, so the host key is not verified. It affects curl 7.81.0 through 8.20.0 and is fixed in 8.21.0 (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-12064.html) by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/ab3bb8cd8be8f9d4acb97da0418abc279182041e (config2setopts: use default protocol properly), which makes the tool ask libcurl for the scheme with CURLU_NO_GUESS_SCHEME when a default protocol is set. DHI curl for Alpine 3.23 is built from Alpine's main/curl recipe (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/3.23-stable/main/curl/APKBUILD) and each build carries the upstream curl release named by its version, as the libcurl/X.Y.Z version string in libcurl.so shows. We disassembled config2setopts in /usr/bin/curl of every published build for Alpine 3.23 (8.17.0-r1 to the current 8.23.0-r1, x86_64 and aarch64), using the symbols in curl-dbg: the builds from 8.17.0-r1 to 8.20.0-r1 carry curl 8.20.0 or older and never pass the CURLU_NO_GUESS_SCHEME flag; from 8.21.0-r0 on they carry 8.21.0 or later and do. Every build's libcurl is also built without an SSH backend (it links neither libssh2 nor libssh), so it cannot make SFTP or SCP transfers; the range follows the code fix regardless. The range ends at 8.21.0-r0, the first build with the fix.
